mesh.loftedReadOnly: A lofted mesh is read-only here: convert it to vertices + faces first
mesh.noneUnused: Every vertex is in a face
mesh.confirmReplace: Replace the whole mesh with the primitive?
mesh.view3dTip: 3D view, key 4. Orbit: middle button + Shift (or Alt + drag)
mesh.toolSelectTip: Select and move vertices (S). Click an edge to select its two vertices, inside a face to select the face; drag on empty space for a box.
mesh.toolAddTip: Add vertices (A): click on the view plane; new vertices join the selection in order, ready for Make face
mesh.displayTip: Wireframe shows every edge (smooth edges dashed); vpy3d shows only what vpy3d_draw_mesh draws from this angle (W)
mesh.snapTip: Snap moved and added vertices to the grid in the front/top/side views
mesh.notJson: This document is not a .vmesh JSON object. Add a primitive to start a new mesh (it replaces the text).
mesh.loftedBanner: Lofted from {{n}} sections: a read-only preview.
mesh.convertTip: Replace the sections with the vertices and faces they loft into, so they can be edited
mesh.name: Name
mesh.hardTip: Two faces meeting more sharply than this keep their shared edge as a line (vpy3d "hard"). 45 is the default; 0 = every edge is a line.
mesh.hardCosNote: "hard_cos" is set and overrides the angle.
mesh.openTip: A plate rather than a solid: its rim is drawn from either side
mesh.capsTip: Close the two ends of the loft
mesh.selectHint: Click a vertex, an edge or a face. Shift adds; drag a box on empty space.
mesh.makeFaceTip: Make a face from the selected vertices, in the order you selected them (F)
mesh.connectTip: Connect two corners of the same face: splits the face along a new edge (J)
mesh.disconnectTip: Remove the edge between two vertices by merging the two faces either side (K)
mesh.flipTip: Reverse the winding of the selected face (N)
mesh.deleteTip: Delete the selected vertices (and their faces), line/occluder points, or the selected face (Del)
mesh.windTip: Re-wind every face anticlockwise seen from outside (normal away from the centre)
mesh.unusedTip: Delete vertices that no face uses
mesh.addPrimTip: Add the primitive at the origin, next to what is there
mesh.replacePrimTip: Replace the whole mesh with the primitive
mesh.flippedTip: Wound inward: vpy3d flips its normal at load, but it is better wound outward
mesh.valid: Compiles, and vpy3d can load it.
mesh.errorsNote: Errors: vpy_cli refuses the file (the build fails). Warnings: it builds, but vpy3d may refuse or misdraw it.
mesh.help: Middle drag: pan · Shift+middle or Alt+drag: orbit · wheel: zoom · 1-4: views · F face · J connect · K disconnect · N flip · L line (Enter ends, Esc cancels) · O occluder · B box occluder · Del delete · arrows nudge (Shift ×10) · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y
mesh.deletedPoints: Deleted {{n}} point(s); a line left with 1 point or an occluder with 2 goes too
mesh.lineNeedsTwo: A line needs at least 2 points
mesh.needSelection: Select vertices or line points first
mesh.occFlat: The selection spans a line or a point: an occluder needs an area
mesh.occNeedsOrtho: Drag an occluder box in the front, top or side view (keys 1-3)
mesh.toolLineTip: Draw a line (L): click points on the view plane (or onto a vertex / point), Enter or double-click ends it, Esc cancels
mesh.toolOccTip: Drag a box occluder on the front, top or side view (O)
mesh.showOccTip: Show the occluders (never drawn by the game) as a faint orange hull
mesh.lineBrTip: Percent of the brightness the mesh is drawn with (1-100, "br"; 100 is the default)
mesh.lineClosedTip: Join the last point back to the first ("closed")
mesh.sceneryNote: Lines are drawn as they are, cut by the occluders the game added before this mesh. Occluders are never drawn: added after the mesh, they hide what is drawn later behind them.
mesh.newLineClosedTip: Lines drawn with the Line tool join their last point to the first
mesh.occDepthTip: Thickness along the view direction of an occluder dragged with the Occluder tool; 0 = a flat wall on the view plane
mesh.boxOccTip: An occluder that is the bounding box of the selected vertices and points (B)
mesh.lineFogTip: Off: the line ignores the scenery fog (vpy3d_set_scenery_fog), "fog": false
scene.badGroupName: A group name must be new and not start with "!"
scene.viewEyeTip: Perspective from the eye point, looking along +z: roughly what a game with the camera there sees (key 0)
scene.view3dTip: 3D view, key 4. Orbit: left drag, or middle button + Shift
scene.softTip: Show the smooth edges of faces (vpy3d draws them only on the silhouette)
scene.showOccTip: Show the occluders (never drawn by the game) as a faint orange hull
scene.fogPreviewTip: Dim by the scene fog, taking the depth as z minus the eye's z (the game uses its camera's depth)
scene.eyeTip: Where the eye view looks from (along +z)
scene.reloadTip: Read the meshes again from assets/meshes
scene.orderNote: Drawn top to bottom: an item's occluders hide only the items below it, so list the near pieces first.
scene.addItemTip: Add an item after the selected one
scene.groupsNote: The game passes a groups mask to vpy3d_draw_scene: bit n is the n-th group. The checkboxes are the preview's mask.
scene.maskTip: Preview with this group's bit set
scene.deleteGroupTip: Delete the group; its items are drawn always again
scene.fogOnTip: Fade the pieces with depth: full brightness up to "full", gone at "gone" (how, per item: its Fog)
scene.name: Name
scene.validNoList: No errors (the meshes could not be listed, so they were not checked).
scene.notJson: This document is not a .vscene JSON object.
scene.startNew: Start a new scene (replaces the text)
scene.speedTip: pos.z units per second while playing (negative goes back)
scene.posTip: The game's pos[3]: how far it has gone along each axis
scene.noItem: Select an item, or add one.
scene.itemNameTip: A label for you; the game does not see it
scene.meshTip: The .vmesh pieces (assets/meshes). Several meshes take turns along a repeat: copy n uses mesh n mod their count.
scene.addMeshTip: Add a mesh to take turns with (needs a repeat)
scene.noMeshes: No .vmesh in assets/meshes yet: create one first (File > New > 3D Mesh).
scene.atTip: Where the piece stands: whole numbers, a missing axis is 0
scene.followTip: How far the piece moves per unit of pos, per axis: -1 on z comes at you as pos.z grows; 0.9167 on x slides by almost as fast as you turn. Kept to 1/65536.
scene.repeatTip: "count" copies "step" apart along "axis"; they wrap with the movement, so the first is always within one step of "at"
scene.windowTip: Draw a copy only while its z in the world is within min..max (each bound optional): the near bays only, nothing behind the camera
scene.groupedOut: switched off by the groups mask
scene.brTip: Percent of the brightness the scene is drawn at (1-100; blank = 100)
scene.fogModeTip: true: each scenery line segment by its depth (faces keep their brightness); "whole": each copy as one, faces included, by the depth of its origin (skipped when too dim); false: never faded
scene.groupTip: Drawn only while that group's bit is set; "!name": only while it is clear
scene.help: Click a piece to select its item · left drag: pan (orbit in 3D) · middle drag: pan · Shift+middle or Alt+drag: orbit · wheel: zoom · 0-4: views · Space: play · Up/Down: item · Alt+Up/Down: move item · Ctrl+D duplicate · Del delete · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y
anim3d.reloadTip: Read the skeleton and the meshes again from disk
anim3d.newSetQ: Name of the new set (a character or a style)
anim3d.noPose: Select a pose, or add one.
anim3d.noClip: Select a clip, or add one.
anim3d.keyNewPoseTip: A new pose from what the view shows now, keyed at the playhead
anim3d.noSet: Select a set, or add one.
anim3d.help: Click a joint in the view to find its sliders · drag: orbit (3D) or pan · middle drag: pan · wheel: zoom · Space: play · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y
anim3d.notJson: This document is not a .vclip JSON object.
anim3d.startNew: Start a new library (replaces the text)
anim3d.unitsHelp: Degrees, and the file's own units ({{u}} per turn)
anim3d.playTip: Play at the game's 50 frames a second (Space)
anim3d.ghostTip: Draw the last key passed, faintly
anim3d.jointRenameNote: Renaming a joint does not rename it in the .vclip files that pose it: edit those too.
anim3d.newVariantQ: Name of the new variant (a character)
anim3d.variantBone: "{{b}}" belongs to the variant: edit it as text.
anim3d.noBone: Select a bone (here or in the view).
anim3d.offsetTip: Where its joint is, in the parent's frame (x right, y up, z ahead)
anim3d.turnHelp: Each turn: joint × mul ÷ div + add (whole numbers, as C computes it). x swings a hanging limb forward, y turns +z towards +x, z turns +x towards +y.
anim3d.limitTip: Optional: the slider's range, in the file's units
anim3d.noVariant: Select a variant, or add one.
anim3d.scaleTip: Q8: 256 = as modelled. Scales the offsets, the meshes and the sockets.
anim3d.notJsonSkel: This document is not a .vskel JSON object.
anim3d.startNewSkel: Start a new skeleton (replaces the text)
anim3d.fixFirst: Fix the problems listed on the left to see it.
